description: 客户邮件：POC 要求、签字人与预算状态

input.title: 回复：终端安全测试安排
input.text:
陈经理您好，

感谢上周的方案介绍。我们内部讨论后，希望在 11 月 15 日前完成为期两周的 POC，测试范围是 200 台办公终端，重点验证勒索防护和误报率，误报率需要低于 1%。

POC 结论会由我汇总后提交给分管信息科技的副总裁周海峰，最终由他签字。今年的预算已经批了，但金额要等 POC 结果出来后才能最终确定。

另外提醒一下，我们现有厂商的合同 12 月 31 日到期。

信息安全部 经理
林晓

description: 英文会议纪要：评估标准、决策时间与预算上限

input.text:
Attendees: Aisha Rahman (CISO), Kevin Lim (Procurement Manager)

- Aisha confirmed the evaluation will be scored 40% detection efficacy, 30% total cost, 30% local support in Malaysia.
- Kevin said any purchase above MYR 1 million needs board approval, and the next board meeting is on 4 December.
- Aisha mentioned their regulator issued new guidance in September requiring 24x7 monitoring, which is why this project started.
- Kevin asked for a reference customer in Malaysian banking before shortlisting.
